Package dyntabs.ai

Class ListenBuilder

java.lang.Object
dyntabs.ai.ListenBuilder
public class ListenBuilder extends Object
Turns recorded speech into text — the inbound half of the voice channel.

The shortest useful form


 String text = EasyAI.listen().from(audioBytes, "audio/webm");

That is the whole thing. No model builder, no request object, no Base64, no provider name: the model, key and base URL come from easyai.properties, and — the point worth knowing — they default to your chat settings. An app that already talks to an OpenAI-compatible provider for chat gains speech input with no new configuration at all (see VoiceConfig).

Why this exists at all

Voice should be a new channel into the assistant you already have, not a second brain. The transcript this returns is ordinary text, so you hand it to the same assistant — and spoken turns inherit your tools, memory and context for free. That is also why this class returns a String rather than an answer: transcribing and deciding are deliberately separate jobs.

Overriding per call


 String text = EasyAI.listen()
                     .withModel("whisper-large-v3")      // e.g. when the base URL points at Groq
                     .withLanguage("sr")                 // skip language detection
                     .withEventListener(e -> log.info("{}", e))
                     .from(audioBytes, "audio/webm");

Analogy: a dictation service. You slide in the recording and get back a typed page. It does not answer the letter — that is the next desk along.

    • withModel

      public ListenBuilder withModel(String modelName)
      Name the transcription model for this call.

      Needed when the base URL points somewhere other than OpenAI — Groq's Whisper is whisper-large-v3, OpenAI's default is VoiceConfig.DEFAULT_TRANSCRIPTION_MODEL. Nothing is guessed from the URL.

      Parameters:
      modelName - the provider's model id
      Returns:
      this builder

    • withLanguage

      public ListenBuilder withLanguage(String language)
      Tell the model which language to expect, as an ISO-639-1 code (e.g. "sr", "en").

      Leave it unset to let the model detect the language — which is what you want for a bilingual audience, and a real advantage over a browser recognizer pinned to one locale. Set it when you know the language and want the accuracy.

      Parameters:
      language - ISO-639-1 language code
      Returns:
      this builder

    • withEventListener

      public ListenBuilder withEventListener(EasyAIListener eventListener)
      Register a listener for the live EasyAIEvent stream, so a transcription shows up in your activity timeline like every other EasyAI operation.

      Emits EasyAIEvent.Phase.STARTED when the call begins and EasyAIEvent.Phase.RESULT carrying the transcript (or EasyAIEvent.Phase.ERROR), under EasyAIEvent.Source.VOICE. A UI can therefore show what it heard — which is the one thing users most want to verify about a voice interface.

      Parameters:
      eventListener - the listener (may be null to disable events)
      Returns:
      this builder
